Checklist.title: Checklist
Checklist.description: Represents a checklist document stored in Firestore, associated with a specific user.

userId.description: Unique identifier for the user who owns this checklist. This is derived from Firebase Authentication UID.

categories.description: An array of checklist categories, each containing a list of items.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp indicating when the checklist was last updated.

definition.description: Stores the checklist data for a specific user. The 'userId' parameter matches the Firebase Authentication UID. Allows only the owner (identified by userId) to read or write this document.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, derived from Firebase Authentication UID.  Used to enforce ownership.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to store checklist data specific to each user.  It leverages path-based ownership for user data, stored under the `checklists` collection. Each user has their own document containing their checklist data. This structure supports the required QAPs.  Specifically, segregation is used to isolate user data (each user has their own document). Authorization Independence is achieved inherently by the path-based structure `/checklists/{userId}`, as security rules can easily validate that `request.auth.uid == userId`. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls to parent documents during authorization. The design also uses a single document per user to minimize reads/writes and reduce costs.
